assumptions: Unsampled rule (option a): a Trend or Gauge is unmeasured when every finite value it reports is 0. This replaces the min===0&&max===0 rule, which it subsumes; it holds whichever summaryTrendStats are listed. Counters stay measured (count: 0 is a real result), documented in docs/wiki/Ingest-Reporter.md and CHANGELOG.

Default run ref is GITHUB_RUN_ID-GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT-GITHUB_JOB (parts that are set, joined by '-', capped at 200 chars). GitHub Actions exposes no matrix value in the environment and matrix legs share GITHUB_JOB, so GITHUB_JOB is the only stably available job identity; matrix legs must pass --run-ref (documented with a strategy.job-index example).

Parked sub-fork: mismatch detection parked: server response carries no comparable body. The perf-reports answer is { reportId, duplicate } only, so a duplicate always goes down the warn path (CI annotation) and exits 0; no server field was invented.
The unknown-option error echoes the flag name (the part before '='), never the inline value.
prettier --write (repo .prettierrc, printWidth 80) reformatted the touched npm files, which the original PR had not formatted; that reformatting accounts for most of this round's module-size growth.
